title: GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/protocols response
description: Contract addition 2026-11-23 (integration, see ../contract-additions.md): the protocol version list the protocol screen loads with ?limit=100. One version chain per project (0002 UNIQUE(project_id, version)). Every item carries the chain handle (the first version's id) as id, because the screen groups versions by id; per-version identity is (id, version). All /v1/protocols/{id} routes resolve any chain id to the project, so the handle works for GET (?version=N), POST versions and POST lock. Items are protocol objects exactly as in protocol-get.response.json (lockHash/lockedAt only on locked rows). All member roles may read. Pagination: ?limit 1-100 default 20, opaque ?cursor, nextCursor; created_ts DESC, id DESC.
